judge.summary: The AI learned the buyer's central concerns and used the retrieved sensitive-risk FAQ well: it gave the available pylon and flood-mitigation facts with appropriate limits. The buyer was not appointment-ready; they explicitly wanted evidence and a spouse review before deciding whether to visit. Escalating the unresolved technical and factual issue was appropriate, but the formal handoff occurred before appointment readiness, so the outcome is AI_EARLY_HANDOFF rather than an appointment-ready handoff success. The handoff left a material readiness blocker (MEDIUM sales work remaining), although Human's fixture-supported work was only LOW sales work: Human restated sourced facts and clarified that requested documents and assessments were unavailable. The human_operations fixture is simulator-only and does not establish real-world document access or technical capability.
judge.concrete_improvement_recommendation: Keep the sourced facts and caveats, but do not promise to obtain documents or technical review unless that capability is verified. State plainly that the actual FAQ and requested assessments are not available in the supplied information, escalate only as an operational request without implying delivery, and leave the lead explicitly NOT_READY with the visit decision pending the buyer's evidence review.
